description: Category codes for the nil-rated / exempted / non-GST table (GSTR-1 table 8). The label is what a workbook must contain; the code is what the payload carries. Beware that inter-state is 'INTR' and intra-state is 'INTRA' — one letter apart, with the longer code belonging to the shorter-sounding word. Order follows the template's dropdown.
